notes: Provisional single-reviewer scores. Functional items rest on the model's in-player evidence (player 16/16 and 7/7, 10 s frame counts) plus an independent reviewer check of the static mirror in headless Edge: zero console errors, zero external requests, search Richter/shrine/bell = 1/1/2, minimap click and Home move the camera, key figures 157.22/157.18/109.12/144.58/86.25/43.35 m, sun 18 deg at 08:00 equinox, 48 source links, no unnamed controls, 3D view keeps 56% of 1440x900 and 42% of 1024x768, 60 fps exterior. Visual deductions: V3 window tracery and gables simplified; V4 interior tall and narrow but plain, flat-shaded piers; V5 exterior reads as pale grey stone rather than the cathedral's dark weathered stone; V7 visible gaps in the nave vault webs and label clutter. Caveat: the run predates the isolation protocol; its working folder was the whole benchmark tree (including the operator kit) and it could read past-session history.
